rationale: Both Pratik and Tejas work in AI/ML at Apple and bring complementary perspectives to building and deploying machine learning systems. Pratik's hands-on experience with LLM inference, language model training, and sparse autoencoders could pair well with Tejas's consulting background to explore practical applications and architectural decisions in production ML.
intro_message: Pratik Doshi, meet Tejas Zodage — you're both in the AI/ML space at Apple and could swap insights on deploying language models and ML infrastructure at scale.
